    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      actions: write
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: finalize
          pull-request: ${{ needs.assess-intent.outputs.number }}
          assessment: ${{ needs.assess-hosted.outputs.assessment || needs.assess-intent.outputs.assessment }}

  request-reassessment:
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && github.event.issue.pull_request && (startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/approve-intent ') || startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/hosted-review '))) ||
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.pull_request != '' && !inputs.check_author)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      actions: write
    needs: resolve-clouseau
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: request-reassessment
          pull-request: ${{ inputs.pull_request }}

  check-author:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.check_author
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - name: Verify independent repair author without writing
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          retries: 3
          github-token: ${{ secrets.CLOUSEAU_REPAIR_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const {data: user} = await github.rest.users.getAuthenticated();
            const {data: repository} = await github.rest.repos.get(context.repo);
            if (user.login === 'github-actions[bot]' || !repository.permissions?.push) {
              throw new Error('Repair requires an independent author with Contents write access');
            }
            core.info(`Independent repair author ${user.login} can access ${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}. No write or deployment was made.`);

# Reference consumer verification-and-review workflow, verified end to end in a
# fresh repository (GitHub-hosted runners, record-transport: job-output, provenance:
# summary). Save as .github/workflows/ci.yml. The bootstrap is referenced as
# gaulatti/clouseau/scripts/resolve@main on purpose: the engine is resolved from protected
# main at run time, so a commit pin on the bootstrap adds little and only goes stale. Do not
# replace @main with a tag, another branch or a fork. The job named "verify" and its
# step names must match "verification" in .github/clouseau.json; adapt the install and
# test steps to your stack. Secrets (all optional, see docs/quickstart.md):
# DEEPSEEK_API_KEY, TYPESAFE_API_KEY, CLOUSEAU_REPAIR_TOKEN (the repair author; the gate's update-token too).
name: CI
run-name: >-
  ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && format('Verify PR #{0}', github.event.pull_request.number) ||
      inputs.check_author && 'Verify repair author' ||
      format('PR review ({0})', github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.issue.number || inputs.pull_request || github.ref_name) }}
on:
  push:
    branches: ['policy-install/**']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review]
  pull_request_target:
    branches: [main]
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened, ready_for_review, edited]
  issue_comment:
    types: [created]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pull_request:
        description: PR number to reassess without executing contributor code; empty runs verification
        type: string
        required: false
      check_author:
        description: Inspect existing repair author identity and repository access without writing or deploying
        type: boolean
        default: false
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.event.issue.number || inputs.pull_request || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true
jobs:
  resolve-clouseau:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
    outputs:
      sha: ${{ steps.engine.outputs.sha }}
      digest: ${{ steps.engine.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - id: engine
        uses: gaulatti/clouseau/scripts/resolve@main
        with:
          provenance: summary

  # Optional: skip the checks a valid local receipt already attests (docs/local-review.md, "Receipt-attested verification").
  # Any other outcome, including an error here, leaves `attested` unset and `verify` runs every check.
  attested:
    needs: resolve-clouseau
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      attested: ${{ steps.decide.outputs.attested }}
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Decide whether a local receipt attests the verification
        id: decide
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        continue-on-error: true
        uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: attested
          config: .github/clouseau.json

  verify:
    # Schedule the job so GitHub resolves its name, including metadata events.
    # Step guards keep those events from running contributor code.
    name: >-
      ${{ (github.event_name == 'pull_request' ||
          (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.pull_request == '' && !inputs.check_author)) && 'verify' || 'metadata-only' }}
    needs: [resolve-clouseau, attested]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        # `attested` is 'true' only for a pull request whose receipt attests this exact head; then every step is skipped and the
        # engine accepts the skipped required steps because it verifies the same receipt itself.
        if: &verify-code >-
          (github.event_name == 'pull_request' ||
          (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.pull_request == '' && !inputs.check_author)) &&
          needs.attested.outputs.attested != 'true'
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        if: *verify-code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Verify the frozen Clouseau engine
        if: *verify-code
        uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: verify-engine
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        if: *verify-code
        with:
          node-version: '22'
      - name: Select accepted verification recipe
        if: *verify-code
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
        run: |
          if test -n "$BASE_SHA" && git cat-file -e "$BASE_SHA:.clouseau-local.json" 2>/dev/null; then
            git show "$BASE_SHA:.clouseau-local.json" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/clouseau-coverage.json"
          else
            cp .clouseau-local.json "$RUNNER_TEMP/clouseau-coverage.json"
          fi
      - name: Install verification dependencies
        if: *verify-code
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Run tests and measure native coverage
        if: *verify-code
        run: npm run test:coverage
      - name: Enforce 100% line and branch coverage
        if: *verify-code
        uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: coverage
          coverage-config: ${{ runner.temp }}/clouseau-coverage.json

  assess-intent:
    if: &review-event >-
      (github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft) ||
      (github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/policy-install/'))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 70
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read
    outputs:
      assessment: ${{ steps.local-review.outputs.assessment || steps.assess.outputs.assessment }}
      review-record: ${{ steps.local-review.outputs.review-record || steps.assess.outputs.review-record }}
      number: ${{ steps.install.outputs.number || github.event.pull_request.number }}
      # 'true' only when the receipt-only route found the receipt unusable; the only data that leaves this job towards assess-hosted
      hosted: ${{ steps.fallback.outputs.hosted }}
    needs: resolve-clouseau
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - name: Verify the owner-authorized frozen reviewer installation
        if: github.event_name == 'push'
        id: install
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          retries: 3
          script: |
            const match = context.ref.match(/^refs\/heads\/policy-install\/pr-([1-9][0-9]*)$/);
            if (context.actor !== context.repo.owner || !/^[a-f0-9]{40}$/.test(context.sha) || !match) {
              throw new Error('Reviewer installation requires the repository owner and a ready PR number');
            }
            const pull_number = Number(match[1]);
            if (!Number.isSafeInteger(pull_number)) throw new Error('Invalid installation PR number');
            const {data: pr} = await github.rest.pulls.get({...context.repo, pull_number});
            if (pr.state !== 'open' || pr.draft || pr.base.ref !== 'main' ||
                pr.user.login !== context.repo.owner || pr.head.sha !== context.sha ||
                pr.head.repo?.full_name !== `${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}`) {
              throw new Error('Installation requires the owner-authored same-repository PR at this exact workflow revision');
            }
            const comments = await github.paginate(github.rest.issues.listComments,
              {...context.repo, issue_number: pull_number, per_page: 100});
            if (!comments.some(comment => comment.user?.type === 'User' && comment.user.login === context.repo.owner &&
                comment.body.trim() === `/approve-intent ${context.sha}`)) {
              throw new Error('Installation requires owner intent confirmation at this exact revision');
            }
            core.setOutput('number', String(pull_number));
      # Never load the controller or its configuration from the PR.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Wait for tests and exact coverage
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          REQUESTED_PR: ${{ steps.install.outputs.number }}
        with:
          retries: 3
          script: |
            const path = require('node:path');
            const root = path.resolve('.clouseau-ci');
            const config = require(path.join(root, 'src/config.cjs')).loadConfig('.github/clouseau.json');
            const policy = require(path.join(root, 'src/policy.cjs')).createPolicy(config, {engine: require(path.join(root, 'src/central-version.cjs')).environmentEngine()});
            const number = context.payload.pull_request?.number || Number(process.env.REQUESTED_PR);
            for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 120; attempt++) {
              const {data: pr} = await github.rest.pulls.get({...context.repo, pull_number: number});
              const expected = context.payload.pull_request?.head.sha || context.sha;
              if (pr.state !== 'open' || pr.draft || pr.head.sha !== expected) {
                throw new Error('PR closed, became draft, or changed while verification was pending');
              }
              const result = await policy.technicalRun(github, context.repo, pr);
              if (result.failure) throw new Error(result.failure);
              if (!result.pending) { core.info(`Verified PR CI: ${result.url}. Clouseau acceptance can now start.`); return; }
              core.info('Waiting for independent verification and exact coverage. No AI request has been made.');
              await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 15000));
            }
            throw new Error('PR verification did not complete within 30 minutes');
      - name: Select authenticated local review or the installed CI reviewer
        id: review-route
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          retries: 3
          script: |
            core.setOutput('local', String((context.payload.pull_request?.body || '').includes('clouseau-local-review:v1')));
      - name: Verify authenticated local review without AI credentials
        if: steps.review-route.outputs.local == 'true'
        id: local-review
        uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: verify-local
          record-transport: job-output
          pull-request: ${{ steps.install.outputs.number }}
          wait-for-verification: 'false'
      - name: Hand an unusable receipt to the separate hosted review
        if: steps.review-route.outputs.local == 'true'
        id: fallback
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        env:
          ASSESSMENT: ${{ steps.local-review.outputs.assessment }}
        with:
          retries: 3
          script: |
            const assessment = JSON.parse(process.env.ASSESSMENT);
            core.setOutput('hosted', String(assessment.decision === 'review_incomplete' && assessment.cause === 'local_receipt_unusable'));
      - name: Review unstamped PR through the installed CI AI reviewer
        if: steps.review-route.outputs.local != 'true'
        uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        id: assess
        with:
          operation: assess
          record-transport: job-output
          pull-request: ${{ steps.install.outputs.number }}
          wait-for-verification: 'false'
          provider-key: ${{ secrets.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY }}
          typesafe-key: ${{ secrets.TYPESAFE_API_KEY }}

  # Runs in this same workflow run only when the receipt-only job above found the receipt unusable. This is
  # the only job that holds the provider secrets for a PR that carries a receipt marker, and it never reads the
  # receipt (ignore-receipt) or any value derived from it: it receives just the PR number and the frozen engine.
  assess-hosted:
    if: needs.assess-intent.outputs.hosted == 'true'
    needs: [assess-intent, resolve-clouseau]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 70
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read
    outputs:
      assessment: ${{ steps.assess.outputs.assessment }}
      review-record: ${{ steps.assess.outputs.review-record }}
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      # Never load the controller or its configuration from the PR.
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Review the change through the installed CI AI reviewer, ignoring the receipt
        uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        id: assess
        with:
          operation: assess
          ignore-receipt: 'true'
          record-transport: job-output
          pull-request: ${{ needs.assess-intent.outputs.number }}
          wait-for-verification: 'false'
          provider-key: ${{ secrets.DEEPSEEK_API_KEY }}
          typesafe-key: ${{ secrets.TYPESAFE_API_KEY }}

  approve-and-merge:
    name: ${{ ((github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft) || (github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/policy-install/'))) && 'approve-and-merge' || 'metadata-only-approval' }}
    needs: [assess-intent, assess-hosted, resolve-clouseau]
    # Always resolve the job name; only trusted, ready PR events run its steps.
    # A failed assessment must still fail the required native approval check.
    if: always()
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
      issues: write
      actions: write
    concurrency:
      group: pr-approval-${{ needs.assess-intent.outputs.number || github.run_id }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - name: Require a completed assessment
        if: >-
          ((github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft) ||
          (github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/policy-install/'))) &&
          (needs.assess-intent.result != 'success' || contains(fromJSON('["failure","cancelled"]'), needs.assess-hosted.result))
        run: exit 1
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        if: *review-event
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        if: *review-event
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - if: *review-event
        uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: gate
          record-transport: job-output
          # Exactly one acceptance record per head: the hosted review's when it ran, otherwise the receipt-only job's.
          review-record: ${{ needs.assess-hosted.outputs.review-record || needs.assess-intent.outputs.review-record }}
          pull-request: ${{ needs.assess-intent.outputs.number }}
          native-gate: 'true'
          assessment: ${{ needs.assess-hosted.outputs.assessment || needs.assess-intent.outputs.assessment }}
          # The same secret as repair-token. Used only under the protected local_review.base_moved "update" (docs/local-review.md),
          # to merge a moved base into the branch server-side; without that setting the gate never reads it.
          update-token: ${{ secrets.CLOUSEAU_REPAIR_TOKEN }}

  apply-repair:
    needs: [assess-intent, assess-hosted, approve-and-merge, resolve-clouseau]
    if: >-
      always() && github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft &&
      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&
      needs.assess-intent.result == 'success' && contains(fromJSON('["success","skipped"]'), needs.assess-hosted.result) &&
      needs.approve-and-merge.result == 'failure' &&
      fromJSON(needs.assess-hosted.outputs.assessment || needs.assess-intent.outputs.assessment).repair_digest != ''
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write
      pull-requests: read
      actions: read
    concurrency:
      group: pr-approval-${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: repair
          record-transport: job-output
          review-record: ${{ needs.assess-hosted.outputs.review-record || needs.assess-intent.outputs.review-record }}
          assessment: ${{ needs.assess-hosted.outputs.assessment || needs.assess-intent.outputs.assessment }}
          repair-token: ${{ secrets.CLOUSEAU_REPAIR_TOKEN }}

  finalize-merge:
    needs: [assess-intent, assess-hosted, approve-and-merge, resolve-clouseau]
    # assess-hosted is skipped whenever a receipt is used; without a status function GitHub would skip this job too.
    if: >-
      !cancelled() && needs.approve-and-merge.result == 'success' &&
      ((github.event_name == 'pull_request_target' && !github.event.pull_request.draft) ||
      (github.event_name == 'push' && !github.event.deleted && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/policy-install/')))
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      actions: write
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: finalize
          pull-request: ${{ needs.assess-intent.outputs.number }}
          assessment: ${{ needs.assess-hosted.outputs.assessment || needs.assess-intent.outputs.assessment }}

  request-reassessment:
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'issue_comment' && github.event.issue.pull_request && (startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/approve-intent ') || startsWith(github.event.comment.body, '/hosted-review '))) ||
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.pull_request != '' && !inputs.check_author)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      actions: write
    needs: resolve-clouseau
    env:
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_SHA: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha }}
      CLOUSEAU_ENGINE_DIGEST: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.digest }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Check out this run frozen Clouseau engine
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: gaulatti/clouseau
          ref: ${{ needs.resolve-clouseau.outputs.sha || '0000000000000000000000000000000000000000' }}
          path: .clouseau-ci
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: ./.clouseau-ci
        with:
          operation: request-reassessment
          pull-request: ${{ inputs.pull_request }}

  check-author:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.check_author
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 3
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - name: Verify independent repair author without writing
        uses: actions/github-script@v7
        with:
          retries: 3
          github-token: ${{ secrets.CLOUSEAU_REPAIR_TOKEN }}
          script: |
            const {data: user} = await github.rest.users.getAuthenticated();
            const {data: repository} = await github.rest.repos.get(context.repo);
            if (user.login === 'github-actions[bot]' || !repository.permissions?.push) {
              throw new Error('Repair requires an independent author with Contents write access');
            }
            core.info(`Independent repair author ${user.login} can access ${context.repo.owner}/${context.repo.repo}. No write or deployment was made.`);

+
+A consumer that sets the protected `local_review.base_moved: "update"` (valid only with `binding: "diff"`; the default
+`"hold"` is today's behavior; see [local review](local-review.md#base-moved-hold-or-update-opt-in)) lets the gate merge a moved
+base into the branch server-side instead of posting the notice when the pull request is approved (including any maintainer confirmation the gate requires), and lets `reconcile-base` update every stale same-repository
+PR in one run instead of one at a time. Upgrade steps:

+1. Pass `update-token` to the gate step of `approve-and-merge`. The reference template passes
+   `update-token: ${{ secrets.CLOUSEAU_REPAIR_TOKEN }}`, the same secret as `repair-token`: one token serves both. Use
+   whatever secret your workflow already passes as `repair-token` (this repository's own workflow calls it `DEPLOYMENT_TOKEN`).
+2. That token must start workflows (a `GITHUB_TOKEN` push starts none) and needs contents: write on the repository. When the
+   base brings changes to `.github/workflows/`, GitHub refuses the update unless the token may also change workflows
+   (a fine-grained token or GitHub App with workflows: write, or a classic token with the `workflow` scope). The gate then
+   fails with GitHub's refusal and nothing is updated. Grant it, or update such a branch by hand.
+3. Set `"base_moved": "update"` under `local_review` in `.github/clouseau.json` (a protected change, confirmed by the owner).
+
+On the updated head only the new head's own `pull_request` run follows: `verify` skips the receipt-covered steps while the
+diff-bound receipt still attests, so they are not re-run on the merged base (as with `clouseau refresh` answering `updated`), no
+reviewer is asked, and under `confirmation: "diff"` the owner's confirmation carries. The old head's gate ends with cause
+`base_update_requested`. Loop bound: an update is requested only for the assessed head with only the base moved, with
+`expected_head_sha`; a rerun sees the new head and requests nothing, the new head carries the new base, and updating a
+branch never moves the base. Without the setting the token is never used.
+
+On a controller-managed private-owner repository (the merge the acceptance controller performs itself), the update happens at
+the gate's first check, before the controller's merge, and the updated head then merges by the same atomic fast-forward. The
+base can still move in the seconds between that check and the controller's own re-read of the pull request; that rare case,
+and an exact-revert record, keep holding with the notice (fail closed) and are updated by the next reconcile or base move.

+### Base moved: hold or update (opt-in)
+
+When the base moves after a pull request was assessed and only the base differs (the live head is still the assessed head), the
+gate stops. The protected `local_review.base_moved` in `.github/clouseau.json` on the base branch says what it does then. It is
+valid only together with `binding: "diff"` (any other combination, or a value other than these two, fails configuration
+validation, like `confirmation`):
+
+| `base_moved` | The gate, after a base-only move |
+| --- | --- |
+| absent or `"hold"` (the default) | posts the `base_moved` needs-branch-update notice and fails, exactly as before; the owner updates the branch |
+| `"update"` | for an approved revision (a decision of `auto_approve` or `owner_decision` and, where the gate requires a maintainer's confirmation: the owner decision itself, a protected path or a bot-authored pull request, that confirmation of this head), merges the base into the branch server-side (`updateBranch` with `expected_head_sha`), posts no notice, and ends the job with cause `base_update_requested` (`Branch updated server-side ...`): this revision is neither approved nor merged, and the new head's own run continues. Anything else (another decision, or a confirmation still outstanding) posts the notice and fails, as under `"hold"`: Clouseau never merges the base into a branch that is not yet approved |
+
+The update needs the gate step's `update-token` input: a token whose push **starts workflows**, with contents: write on the
+repository (a fine-grained PAT or an App token, like `repair-token`; the reference template passes the same
+`CLOUSEAU_REPAIR_TOKEN` secret to both). When the base brings changes to `.github/workflows/`, GitHub also requires workflows
+permission (workflows: write for a fine-grained token or App, the `workflow` scope for a classic token). Without it GitHub
+refuses the update and the gate fails with that refusal, updating nothing. The workflow `GITHUB_TOKEN` cannot be used: a push made with it starts no workflow, so
+the new head would have no verification. Without `update-token` the gate holds as under `"hold"`, and the notice says to set
+the `update-token` input of the gate step. A head in a fork is never updated (the notice says so). When GitHub refuses with
+HTTP 422 (a merge conflict with the base, or a head that moved) the gate falls back to the notice, which says so and asks the
+owner to update by hand; any other refusal fails the job with GitHub's error. Under `"update"`, `reconcile-base` also updates
+**every** stale same-repository pull request in one run instead of one at a time, because under the diff binding a base-only
+update needs no fresh review; under `"hold"` it is unchanged. A repository that does not set `base_moved` is unaffected even
+when the token is supplied.
+
+**What runs on the updated head.** The new head's own `pull_request` run. Its `attested` job answers `'true'` while the
+diff-bound receipt still attests (the diff is unchanged and the base's `.clouseau-local.json` is the signed one), so `verify`
+skips every receipt-covered step; only steps outside the receipt's recipe still run (none in the reference template; this
+repository's own engine self-tests, for example). Then the assessment reuses the receipt with zero CI AI calls: no reviewer is
+asked, and under `confirmation: "diff"` the owner's confirmation carries. The receipt-covered commands are **not** re-run on
+the base merged with the branch. This is the same outcome as `clouseau refresh` answering `updated` today, with the same
+accepted limit (see the test waiver above): a break caused only by the base move is found after merge. When the merge changed
+the diff, the receipt no longer covers it and the new head is verified and reviewed as any new head.
+
+**Loop bound.** The update is requested only when the live head equals the assessed head and only the base moved, and
+`expected_head_sha` makes GitHub refuse if the head moved meanwhile. A rerun of the old head's gate sees the new head, so it
+is not a base-only move and requests nothing: the same (head, base) is updated at most once. The new head's assessment carries
+the new base, so it requests another update only if the base moves again. Updating a branch never moves the base, so two pull
+requests cannot update each other. `src/acceptance-controller-base-moved.test.cjs` and `src/base-reconcile-base-moved.test.cjs`
+prove these at the gate (both base-move checks, including the private-merge boundary) and at reconciliation.

 ## Merge conflict with the base
 
 Cause class `branch_conflict`. GitHub does not start `pull_request` workflows for a pull request that has a merge conflict with its base, so PR verification (tests, exact coverage and package build) never exists for the revision and the pull request would otherwise show nothing. The `pull_request_target` run still starts; while it waits for a verification run that is absent, it reads the pull request's mergeability from GitHub. Only a definite `mergeable: false` in state `dirty` on the assessed head is a conflict: a value still being computed (`mergeable: null`) is re-read up to four times, with waits of 2, 4 and 8 seconds, and if it is still unknown nothing is posted and the ordinary wait continues. A conflict ends the wait at once instead of after the queue grace and replaces the generic pending notice with one comment, `Clouseau: merge conflict`, bound by a hidden marker to the head and the base commit: a rerun posts nothing, a base that moves again updates the same comment, and a new head gets its own. The comment names the base branch (GitHub does not expose which files conflict; the merge in step 1 lists them) and numbers three steps: merge the base and resolve (`git fetch origin && git merge origin/BASE_BRANCH`; never rebase), refresh the review evidence and push once (`clouseau refresh --pr PR_NUMBER ...`, or review, publish, update the marker and push by hand), and wait: verification starts only after the conflict is resolved and pushed.

claims.title: fix(gate): update a moved base only for an approved revision
claims.description:
Add an opt-in protected setting `local_review.base_moved` ("hold" default, or "update"), valid only together with `local_review.binding: "diff"`. With "update", a moved base no longer stops an approved PR. Owner-ordered via the orchestrating session; it makes a base move cost no human action when the change itself is unchanged.
Contract:
- Gate, base-only move, mode "update":
  - With an independent `update-token` client, call updateBranch with expected_head_sha. The job ends with a named outcome, cause base_update_requested, and posts no notice. The new head's own run continues.
  - A 422 (merge conflict or moved head) falls back to the branch-update notice, which then says why.
  - No token: hold as today, with the notice naming the missing `update-token` input.
  - A fork head is never updated, and the notice says so.
  - Any other error surfaces.
- "hold" or absent: today's behaviour byte for byte (tested).
- The same rule applies at the gate's second base-move site, the private-owner merge boundary. A real controller-managed private-owner test covers it: main moves → one update and nothing approved or merged on the old head; then the updated head merges by the atomic fast-forward.
- Reconcile under "update" updates every stale same-repository PR in one run, not one at a time.
- Loop bound: an update is requested only for the assessed head when only the base moved, and expected_head_sha makes GitHub refuse if the head moved. The new head carries the new base, and updating a branch never moves the base (tested).
- Template: approve-and-merge's gate step passes `update-token: ${{ secrets.CLOUSEAU_REPAIR_TOKEN }}`, the same secret already passed as repair-token. It needs contents: write and must start workflows; a GITHUB_TOKEN push starts none. When the base brings changes to .github/workflows/, GitHub also requires workflows permission (workflows: write, or the classic  scope); without it GitHub refuses the update, the gate fails with that refusal and nothing is updated, and the docs say so.
- Docs: what runs on the updated head. The new head's own pull_request run; `verify` skips the receipt-covered steps while the diff-bound receipt attests, so they are not re-run on main+branch, as with refresh → updated. No reviewer is asked, and under confirmation "diff" the owner's confirmation carries. The docs also state the loop bound and the rare race in which the controller's own re-read still holds (fail closed).
Kind: mechanics. Effect on existing consumers: none without the setting; the token is never used without it.
